# Local OCR assets

Tesseract.js 6.0.1; tesseract.js-core 6.1.2 (LSTM, SIMD/non-SIMD). Apache-2.0; bundled licenses. English model from tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast, downloaded2026-10-13, Apache-2.0. Runtime does not call external hosts. Loaded only for pallet QR/OCR cameras; worker terminated on close. Do not convert the gzip model to UTF-8.

Sources: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js and https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast
